mn.d: a hard brittle grey polyvalent metallic element that resembles iron but is not magnetic; used in making steel; occurs in many minerals

mnemonics.d: a method or system for improving the memory

mnemonist.d: an expert in the use of mnemonics; someone able to perform unusual feats of memory

mnemotechnical.d: of or relating to or involved the practice of aiding the memory

mniaceae.d: family of erect mosses with club-shaped paraphyses and the hexagonal cells of the upper leaf surface; sometimes treated as a subfamily of Bryaceae

mnium.d: mosses similar to those of genus Bryum but larger
